# ChartKit JSON spec

> @chartkitdev/core v0.5.0 · https://chartkit.dev/schema/v1.json
> v1 @chartkitdev/core/all. Extra on demand: @chartkitdev/core/charts/<type> or /extra. repair, validate: @chartkitdev/core/validate.

## Rules

- version "1". a11y.alt is one required sentence. dataKey is not a key. data is rows, not {"values":[...]}. Sparkline, mini-area, spike may be numbers. Large: {"columns":{"field":[]}}. mark is options (curve, sampling, layout), not a string.
- repair(spec) returns { spec, ok, errors, applied }. Does not mutate or invent data.
- Gauge, kpi, progress-ring: metric (value, min, max, delta, label). A data object of those fields moves into metric. Donut: x label, y value (not theta, angle, label). axis "y" or "y2". Titles: axes.y.title, axes.y2.title. Types: quantitative, temporal, ordinal, nominal (not categorical).
- Heatmap: x+y+color grid. Calendar: date x plus color, or mark.layout "calendar". Measure is color, not value. grid-heatmap and calendar-heatmap are heatmap plus mark.layout.
- Combo y: [{field, mark:bar}, {field, mark:line, axis:y2}]. Not layer, layers, marks, encoding.bar, or encoding.line. bar, line, area in mark, not type. axis y2 needs axes.y2; repair adds it.
- Bar series: encoding.series, or color when it is not x (color equal to x colours bars, no split). mark.stack stack or percent. scale.type log. Temporal x. format formats ticks. Rule, band, and text annotations are drawn. @chartkitdev/core/interact. auto is Soft. midnight is opt-in.
- Extra on demand. Histogram bins x (bins 8, binWidth, or bin count/width/sturges/sqrt/fd); y is a count. Funnel x+y (bar, or trapezoid). Bullet mark.ranges. Waterfall mark.total is absolute.
- ChartKit accepts Mermaid xychart, pie, sankey, radar and treemap syntax via fromMermaid/toSpec.

## line

```json
{"version":"1","type":"line","data":[{"quarter":"Q1","units":40},{"quarter":"Q2","units":55}],"encoding":{"x":"quarter","y":"units"},"a11y":{"alt":"Units rose in Q2."}}
```

## bar

```json
{"version":"1","type":"bar","data":[{"lane":"A","stops":12},{"lane":"C","stops":15}],"encoding":{"x":"lane","y":"stops"},"a11y":{"alt":"Lane C has more."}}
```

## donut

```json
{"version":"1","type":"donut","data":[{"wood":"Oak","boards":8},{"wood":"Pine","boards":5}],"encoding":{"x":"wood","y":"boards"},"a11y":{"alt":"Oak is larger."}}
```

## stacked-area

```json
{"version":"1","type":"stacked-area","data":[{"year":"2022","rail":20,"road":30},{"year":"2023","rail":24,"road":28}],"encoding":{"x":"year","y":["rail","road"]},"a11y":{"alt":"Road stayed larger."}}
```

## scatter

```json
{"version":"1","type":"scatter","data":[{"temp":16,"yieldKg":3},{"temp":22,"yieldKg":5}],"encoding":{"x":"temp","y":"yieldKg"},"a11y":{"alt":"Yield peaks at 22."}}
```

## combo

```json
{"version":"1","type":"combo","data":[{"week":"W1","orders":30,"rate":0.4},{"week":"W2","orders":36,"rate":0.55}],"encoding":{"x":"week","y":[{"field":"orders","mark":"bar"},{"field":"rate","mark":"line","axis":"y2"}]},"axes":{"y2":{"title":"Fill rate"}},"a11y":{"alt":"Orders and rate rose."}}
```

## heatmap

```json
{"version":"1","type":"heatmap","data":[{"bin":"A","band":"Low","level":1},{"bin":"B","band":"Low","level":4}],"encoding":{"x":"bin","y":"band","color":"level"},"a11y":{"alt":"Bin B is darker."}}
```

## gauge

```json
{"version":"1","type":"gauge","metric":{"label":"Capacity","value":64,"min":0,"max":100},"a11y":{"alt":"Capacity is 64/100."}}
```

## kpi

```json
{"version":"1","type":"kpi","metric":{"label":"Tickets","value":18,"delta":-0.05},"a11y":{"alt":"Tickets are 18, down."}}
```

## sparkline

```json
{"version":"1","type":"sparkline","data":[4,6,5,9,8],"a11y":{"alt":"It ends higher."}}
```

## mini-area

```json
{"version":"1","type":"mini-area","data":[2,3,3,6,5],"a11y":{"alt":"It rises, then eases."}}
```

## progress-ring

```json
{"version":"1","type":"progress-ring","metric":{"label":"Done","value":3,"min":0,"max":8},"a11y":{"alt":"3 of 8 are done."}}
```

## spike

```json
{"version":"1","type":"spike","data":[{"slot":"t1","hits":0},{"slot":"t2","hits":6}],"encoding":{"x":"slot","y":"hits"},"a11y":{"alt":"Hits spike at t2."}}
```

## candlestick

```json
{"version":"1","type":"candlestick","data":[{"day":"D1","open":5,"high":7,"low":4,"close":6},{"day":"D2","open":6,"high":6,"low":3,"close":4}],"encoding":{"x":"day","open":"open","high":"high","low":"low","close":"close"},"a11y":{"alt":"D2 closed down."}}
```

## histogram

```json
{"version":"1","type":"histogram","data":[{"score":1},{"score":2},{"score":2},{"score":8}],"encoding":{"x":"score"},"mark":{"bins":2},"a11y":{"alt":"Scores cluster low."}}
```

## boxplot

```json
{"version":"1","type":"boxplot","data":[{"group":"A","value":1},{"group":"A","value":3},{"group":"A","value":9},{"group":"B","value":2},{"group":"B","value":4},{"group":"B","value":5}],"encoding":{"x":"group","y":"value"},"a11y":{"alt":"A stretches higher."}}
```

## radar

```json
{"version":"1","type":"radar","data":[{"spoke":"Speed","car":4,"bike":2},{"spoke":"Cost","car":2,"bike":5},{"spoke":"Ease","car":3,"bike":4}],"encoding":{"x":"spoke","y":["car","bike"]},"a11y":{"alt":"Bike leads on cost."}}
```

## funnel

```json
{"version":"1","type":"funnel","data":[{"stage":"Visit","count":80},{"stage":"Pay","count":12}],"encoding":{"x":"stage","y":"count"},"a11y":{"alt":"12 of 80 pay."}}
```

## treemap

```json
{"version":"1","type":"treemap","data":[{"name":"Oak","size":8,"group":"Wood"},{"name":"Steel","size":6,"group":"Metal"}],"encoding":{"x":"name","y":"size","color":"group"},"a11y":{"alt":"Oak is larger."}}
```

## sankey

```json
{"version":"1","type":"sankey","data":[{"from":"Source","to":"Mill","flow":10},{"from":"Mill","to":"Shop","flow":6}],"encoding":{"source":"from","target":"to","y":"flow"},"a11y":{"alt":"Flow leaves the mill."}}
```

## bullet

```json
{"version":"1","type":"bullet","data":[{"name":"Revenue","value":275,"target":250,"good":300}],"encoding":{"x":"name","y":"value","target":"target"},"mark":{"ranges":["good"]},"a11y":{"alt":"Revenue beats target."}}
```

## waterfall

```json
{"version":"1","type":"waterfall","data":[{"step":"Open","amount":120,"total":true},{"step":"Won","amount":40},{"step":"Close","amount":160,"total":true}],"encoding":{"x":"step","y":"amount"},"a11y":{"alt":"The close is 160."}}
```
